title: AgentWorld: Personality-Aware Reliability Evaluation for Agentic Information Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.24076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluation of agentic information retrieval remains limited to scripted interactions with uniform users, missing both natural personality diversity and adversarial brittleness. We present AgentWorld, a simulation framework combining (i)Big Five (OCEAN) personality-driven user populations with stateful tool-use environments; (ii)the pass$^k$ consistency metric with structured fault classification, partial-credit scoring, and dual-control handoff verification; (iii)score-thresholded training-data export in six fine-tuning formats; and (iv)an adversarial Risk Analyser that snapshots required-intermediate-state spines, branches Monte-Carlo rollouts under four task-aware perturbation types, and quantifies risk via $\Delta P / \Delta T$ scoring, Dempster--Shafer evidence fusion, and Shapley attack-category attribution. translated_title: AgentWorld：面向智能体信息检索的人格感知可靠性评估
translated_abstract: 智能体信息检索的评估目前仍局限于与统一用户的脚本化交互，既缺乏自然的人格多样性，也未能覆盖对抗性脆弱性。我们提出了AgentWorld，一个仿真框架，它结合了：（i）基于大五人格（OCEAN）驱动的用户群体与有状态工具使用环境；（ii）pass^k一致性指标，以及结构化故障分类、部分信用评分和双控制交接验证；（iii）阈值化训练数据导出，支持六种微调格式；以及（iv）一个对抗性风险分析器，它快照所需中间状态脊柱，在四种任务感知扰动类型下进行蒙特卡洛分支展开，并通过ΔP/ΔT评分、Dempster–Shafer证据融合和Shapley攻击类别归因来量化风险。三个实验验证了该框架：一个跨10种OCEAN人格的对话分析智能体（240个评估者判断）。
tldr: 本文提出AgentWorld框架，通过人格驱动的用户仿真、一致性评估指标、数据导出和对抗性风险分析，全面评估智能体信息检索的可靠性和脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AgentWorld, a framework that comprehensively evaluates the reliability and brittleness of agentic information retrieval through personality-driven user simulation, consistency metrics, data export, and adversarial risk analysis.
